lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Safely Operating Near Oversize & Overweight Vehicles
prompt: Why do heavy commercial trucks gain substantial momentum and speed when descending steep Texas hills?

options.text: Truck diesel engines are required by law to accelerate downhill to conserve fuel
Massive gross weight increases downhill momentum, and heavy braking causes thermal brake fade
Commercial trucks have antilock braking systems that disengage automatically on grades
Air brakes lose all internal pneumatic pressure whenever vehicle climbs a hill
